hypothesis: matched-camera generated train-side data improves scene-held-out generalization on frozen kujiale_0271
outcome: metrics worsen (SR -6pp, SPL -0.068, NE +1.32 m, longer trajectories)
pre_registered_interpretation: generated data increases volume but not useful distributional coverage; keep incumbent
claim: The expanded-data model was trained with 191 original plus 130 generated top-down train-side episodes and evaluated once on the frozen scene-held-out test scene kujiale_0271. This tests the effect of matched-camera generated training data. It is not a full VLNVerse benchmark submission.
